title: High Dose and Low Dose of Atorvastatin in Patients With Unstable Angina and NSTEMI (Non ST Elevation MI)

sections.abstract: The aim of this study is to compare the effect of high dose and low dose of Atorvastatin in reduction level of C-reactive protein (CRP) in patients with unstable angina and NSTEMI (Non ST Elevation MI) attending Shahid Mohammadi hospital in Bandar Abbas.
